title: Merge gate and stage machine speak checkpoints

story.as_a: orchestrator evaluating a thread for merge
story.i_want_to: run the merge precondition against a recorded checkpoint with no pull request
story.so_that: a thread-mode repository can reach an allow at all

rationale: MergePrecondition requires pr_number and a pull_request fact today; PRD §3 and §7 story 4.

acceptance_criteria.description: An intake source carries a mode, pr or thread, defaulting to pr, settable through the intake_source_enroll and intake_source_update MCP tools. The mode is bound per implement dispatch at placement: the dispatch's ledger row records the source's mode when it is first sent, and the merge gate reads the mode of the story's current claim's dispatch, with a legacy row read as pr. A mode change is always allowed and affects only later placements, so existing stories behave exactly as before.
For a thread-mode story, MergePrecondition evaluates the latest recorded checkpoint through a checkpoint implementation of the PullRequestSource facts, needing no pr_number.

When the thread branch is missing from a repository the token can read, names a commit nobody recorded, names an earlier checkpoint of the current claim, the latest checkpoint is not the head the stage recorded, or the comparison's merge base is not the base branch's head, the head has moved (branch_missing, branch_head_unrecorded, branch_head_regressed, base_moved_since_checkpoint): while the claim is live the gate answers head_moved and returns the story to implementing over base_moved without escalating; when the claim is not live it refuses naming claim_not_live and escalates, because nobody can record the fix. It refuses empty_change when the checkpoint tree equals the base tree or the comparison lists no changed file, and claim_ended when the current claim recorded no checkpoint but an earlier claim did.
A recorded allow names the checkpoint id and its SHA.

test_cases.name: pr-mode unchanged
steps: run the existing merge precondition suite

test_cases.name: thread allow
preconditions: thread story at ci with passing checks

technical_notes: The base_update edge (formerly AC-45.4.4) moved to US-45.5 as AC-45.5.7: it has no caller until the merge executor, and cannot be judged safely until US-45.6's CI evidence by exact SHA.
